name: com.buildtool
description: An automation tool that allows you to configure and run sequential builds for different platforms through a dedicated editor window. It has a modular structure and supports custom extensions for automating pre- and post-build tasks. The tool also tracks a shared build index via Git, helping you keep track of build versions and status.

samples.description: Example showing how to implement a custom build pipeline extension with UI Toolkit settings, pre/post-build hooks, and CLI support.
Demonstrates runtime build information display using BuildInfoDisplay prefab and BuildInfoProvider API.
